references.text: Parallel text confirming the genealogy of Sebeon's sons.
Connects Anah as a son of Sebeon (Gen) with Anah as a daughter of Sebeon (Gen 36:14), highlighting genealogical complexities.
Clarifies the relationship between Sebeon and Anah in the genealogy of Seir.
Continues the lineage from Anah to his son Dishon.
